updates.content:
Title: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers

User impact: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers

User impact: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers.

More info: Affected reports include:

- Microsoft 365 group activity reports
- Microsoft Teams usage reports

Current status: Our monitoring has identified delays in certain reporting within the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers. We've analyzed service telemetry and determined that a portion of infrastructure that facilitates report generation isn't processing requests as expected, resulting in in impact. We've developed a fix to improve throughput and are monitoring the request processing rate as it releases.

Scope of impact: Any admin expecting either of the affected reports from Sunday, November 22, 2026, are affected. 

Start time: Sunday, November 22, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Estimated time to resolve: We expect the fix to complete deployment, and mitigation by 9:00 PM UTC on Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

Root cause: A portion of infrastructure that facilitates report generation isn't processing requests as expected, resulting in in impact

Next update by: Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC

Title: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers

User impact: Admins may have noticed delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers.

More info: Affected reports included:

- Microsoft 365 group activity reports
- Microsoft Teams usage reports

Final status: Following the deployment of our fix, our internal service telemetry has verified that request generation and processing has returned to expected levels, and that the impact has been remediated.

Scope of impact: Any admin expecting either of the affected reports from Sunday, November 22, 2026, were affected. 

Start time: Sunday, November 22, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

End time: Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 6:52 PM UTC

Root cause: A portion of infrastructure that facilitates report generation wasn't processing requests as expected, resulting in in impact

Next steps: 
- We're further analyzing the subset of affected service infrastructure to help us isolate the source for the lower-than-expected request processing, and so we can prevent similar issues in the future.  

This is the final update for this event.
